name: r03-ext-v1
note: Extra actor ramps for the R03 (Noah) actors, light to dark, added on top of the unchanged art 03 master palette (byte copy in src/palette_v03.json). Ramp names must not collide with the base. Reused base ramps: bark (club), stone (iron), gold (bronze), leather, bone (grub body, teeth), tunic (rope), smoke (death ash), white, outline, spark.

why.shade: C1 smoke body: dark violet mass that reads darker than grass and lighter than outline; a C1 swarm is the dark field the lighter C2/C3 stand out against
why.ember: C1 eyes and knuckles, C3 and boss eyes: the small hot accent of violence; never a large area
why.chitin: C2 head and mandibles: rust orange, apart from the path tan and from the pale grub body
why.drift: C3 weathered planks: grey-tan, cooler than the dirt path so a C3 on the path keeps its edge
why.pitch: tar on the ark-timber wreckage (C3 seams and drips)
why.giant: boss skin: ashen mauve flesh, apart from grass, from the C1 violet and from the club's warm bark
